source: FRED/ALFRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (underlying data: BEA for GDPC1, PCEPI, PCEPILFE; BLS for UNRATE; Federal Reserve Board for DFEDTAR, DFEDTARU, DFEDTARL)
notes: Latest vintage values, not first releases. GDP and PCE values change with every BEA comprehensive revision, so a later grading step may prefer first-release values (ALFRED vintages). Years 2007 to 2025. Values are computed by Hindsight from the level series with the SEP definitions; they are not errors or grades.

entries.definition: Percent change in the PCE price index excluding food and energy from the fourth quarter of the previous year to the fourth quarter of the year indicated

entries.definition: Average civilian unemployment rate in the fourth quarter of the year indicated
